rationale: Given the unanimity and the Chief’s central role in conference framing (Amerada Hess/Rubin clear-statement and “FSIA gateway” minimalism), Roberts is most likely to keep and write a narrow opinion for the Court. Kagan is the next most likely assignee/author because her statutory-coherence framing is the consensus rationale, with modest concurrence risk from Thomas or Gorsuch to emphasize textualism/separation-of-powers or from Jackson to stress rule-of-law/foreign-relations clarity.
